notes.title: Spooky Pixel Hero - Retro Atari-Style Horror Platformer (Prequel to DERE EXE)
notes.content:
You're tasked by a secret organization to repair a lost platformer game from 1976 that seems way too advanced for its time. But is it really just a game?
Discover the origins of evil. Wishlist Spooky Pixel Hero now!
